outfit.name: 月映琉璃高开叉丝绸旗袍
outfit.prose: an alluring oriental evening style: a sleeveless midnight-sapphire silk cheongsam embroidered with translucent glass camellias, an ultra-high thigh slit revealing slender alabaster legs, keyhole neckline framing soft cleavage, delicate pearl frog closures, and silver ankle-strap heels.
